# QHEBosonsDeltaOverlap

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/QHEBosonsDeltaOverlap`

```text
QHEBosonsOverlap, version 0.01

Usage: QHEBosonsOverlap [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 7)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (default value = 12)
    --lz : twice the momentum projection (default value = 0)
    --exact-state : name of the file containing the vector obtained using exact diagonalization
    --list-wavefunctions : list all available test wave fuctions
    --use-exact : file name of an exact state that has to be used as test wave function

analytical wave function options:
    --test-wavefunction : name of the test wave fuction
    --nbr-flux : number of quantum flux attached to each particle (laughlin and *cf only) (value must be greater than 0, default value = 1)
    --cluster-size : number of particles per cluster (read only) (value must be greater than 2, default value = 3)
    --nbr-level : number of pseudo Landau levels (filledcf only) (value must be greater than 1, default value = 1)
    --cf-file : name of the file describing the composite fermion state (genericcf only)
    --MR-coeff : coefficient for Moore-Read contribution (pairedcf only) (default value = 1)
    --pair-coeff : sequence of pairing coefficients (pairedcf only)
    --pair-compatibility : adopt old conventions for normalisation (pairedcf only)
    --fermion-state : generate a fermionic wavefunction (RR)
    --CF-levels : number of CF levels to fill (><0) (SLBS) (default value = -2)
    --Jz-Value : Total angular momentum Jz (hund only) (default value = 0)
    --hund-L2 : Total angular momentum J if less than maximal (hund only) (default value = -1)
    --JM-Values : Angular momentum J and projection on z axis J,M (paired2QH only)
    --QHMC-iter : Number of MC steps for internal MC (paired2QH only) (default value = 1000)

Monte Carlo options:
    -i, --nbr-iter : number of Monte Carlo iterations (default value = 10000)
    --display-step : number of iteration between two consecutive result displays (default value = 1000)
    --record-step : number of iteration between two consecutive result recording of energy value (0 if no on-disk recording is needed) (default value = 0)
    --record-file : name of the file where energy recording has to be done
    --with-timecoherence : use time coherence between two successive evaluation of the wave function
    --show-details : show intermediate values used for overlap calculation

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
